en: Vintage multi-view postcard showing seaside scenes. The upper large image depicts waves of the sea seen from a coastal garden at sunset or sunrise. The two smaller images below show early 20th‑century sea baths with wooden piers and bathhouses extending into the water, one seen from the sandy beach with vegetation in the foreground, and the other filled with bathers in the sea. Captions in Cyrillic (Bulgarian) and French identify the location as Varna and the sea baths.
